resume_brief: CONCRETE DRAGON — BEAT-EM-UP EVOLUTION (owner directive 2026-10-06). The game is now a 3D side-scrolling BEAT-EM-UP: Streets of Rage / Fatal Fury / Dragon Ball GT: Transformation (GBA) / Streets of Fury inspirations, but 3D. Player walks forward/backward (+depth) across scrolling street levels with missions — NOT stationary 1v1. Foundation: Three.js single-file build in ~/workspace/money-machine-hq/tracks/playable-ads/kit/ (src main.js, dist concrete-dragon.html); repo mhvnsnt/ConcreteDragon at ~/workspace/street-brawl-cicd; Pages deploys the 3D build. PHASE 1 — TEARDOWNS FIRST: teardown Streets of Rage 1-4, Fatal Fury series, Dragon Ball GT: Transformation (GBA), Streets of Fury. Focus: character select screens, menu design language, HUD, level/world structure, enemy variety + variants, unlock/progression. Write docs/BEATEMUP_TEARDOWN.md with concrete menu/character-select design spec (owner says current menus are ugly/boring — spec must fix with reference-backed design). PHASE 2 — BUILD per spec: (1) character select shows ACTUAL 3D model (live, rotatable) — never colored circles; (2) menu overhaul per spec (title/select/shop/results, one cohesive street style); (3) side-scroll movement: walk fwd/back + depth across scrolling levels, camera follows, enemies spawn ahead, mission/level structure; (4) roster: start 3 (Kid Blue/Ghost/Brick, owner can veto); unlock more fighters via missions/boss defeats (beat boss → unlock as playable), data-driven; (5) enemy variants evolving with level progression (visual + behavior); (6) owner-approved features (2026-10-06): heavy attack + special move; DODGE (not block, Urban Reign style); launcher + juggle combos; near-miss bonus; new districts w/ per-district palettes; daily seeded runs; local leaderboards/best-wave; more bosses with real attack patterns; cosmetic supporter skin packs. CROWD CONDITIONAL: sideline crowds only in some missions/levels, NOT everywhere; (7) inviolable: style-not-power (no pay-to-win); 3D-demo naming style (Street Thug/Big Rico, never 2D M1 names); slow-mo + long hit-stop for big moments only; CC0-clean assets w/ license manifest; localStorage save. Also read docs/CONCRETE_DRAGON_SUGGESTIONS.md and fold in what fits. Constraints: work in ~/workspace/street-brawl-cicd, commit INCREMENTALLY, pull/rebase before push, never force-push; keep Pages green; verify in headless browser with screenshots personally inspected (menu, select w/ 3D model, scrolling gameplay, boss).
